services.name: Current Exhibits
services.desc: This exhibit explores the captivating literary heritage of the Hay family and the enduring impact of their written works. At its center is John Milton Hay, the renowned statesman who was also an accomplished poet, novelist, editor, and historian. His writings reflect a life deeply intertwined with the cultural and political world of his era, enriched by close friendships with celebrated authors such as Mark Twain, Rudyard Kipling, and Henry James. The story continues with his grandson, John Hay, who carried the family’s literary tradition into the 20th century. A co‑founder of the Cape Cod Museum of Natural History, he authored eighteen books, writing from his cabin at Brewster’s Dry Hill

services.name: Group Tours
services.desc: The John Hay Estate at The Fells offers a variety of ways in which your group may visit. Private group tours of the house, gardens, or in combination are available to groups of 10 or more people, Monday through Friday, June through August. Guided house tours last approximately one hour and are led by a docent or a member of the Education staff. Guided garden tours last approximately one hour and are led by a docent or a member of the Landscape staff. A minimum of three weeks advance reservation is requested with a deposit of 50% received 14 days prior to the date of tour. The remaining balance to be paid the day of the tour. services.name: Garden Tours
services.desc: Named after the Scottish word for rocky upland pastures, The Fells is situated on a nearly 1,000-acre hillside overlooking scenic Lake Sunapee. It is the former lakeside summer home of American writer and diplomat John M. Hay (1838-1905). Hay’s son Clarence inherited the property and along with his wife Alice Appleton Hay, transformed the rock pasture into extensive formal and informal gardens. They traveled extensively and the series of formal gardens that they built after visiting Italy and France exhibit the best of the 1920's and 30's garden styles. services.name: Weddings and Facility Rentals
services.desc: The Fells is unsurpassed in its classic beauty, elegance, and sophistication. Its historic 22-room Colonial Revival mansion, spectacular events pavilion, and manicured gardens make it the perfect venue for weddings of all sizes. The expansive grounds and facilities provide many options for both ceremony and reception.
